title: 第5章 剑气如虹凝剑域第6章 追蛇入谷险情现
content_zh:
“这位......林师兄，您觉得呢？”
听着严师兄的话，林玄脸色平淡，淡声道：
“当然，修行本是逆天而行，是死是活，全凭个人。”
他的心性早已千锤百炼，对于这几人刚刚的嘲讽，内心是丝毫不起波澜。他曾为天骄之时，不仅仅听多了阿谀奉承，也见过不少底下奉承之人对其他资质不好弟子的冷讽，早已看淡。
“哼，那就好。”
严师兄对于林玄这副淡然的态度，仿佛更加不爽，冷哼一声说着。
很快，一行人便拿着任务竹简，朝着百兽林出发。
......
经过看守法阵弟子核验之后，他们一起走进了传送阵法核心内，只见白光一闪，五人纷纷消失在原地。
下一秒，便出现在了宗门试炼之地，百兽林内。
“祝师妹，何师妹小心了，迅速坠落会导致失重，可别摔倒了。”
俩个师兄来过多次百兽林，很明显知道有一些经验，纷纷提醒着祝红菱跟何师妹，但对另一边林玄是完全不理会。
何师妹感觉到失重之感，慌乱之下险些摔倒，严师兄连忙帮她稳住了身体，紧接着跟何师妹有说有笑的朝着聚集的地方走过来。
而这一边，邱师兄也是跑到了祝红菱身前献着殷勤，只不过祝红菱实力不俗，根本不需要。
几人稳好身体之后，又聚拢在一起。
“本次任务，主要是金木水火土五种属性的二阶妖兽内丹，我知道前面有一个土属性巨背棕熊，刚好就是二阶初期。”邱师兄开口说道。
“确实，那棕熊我也知道，实力相当于元武中阶修士罢了，虽然力大无穷，但我们几人联手对付绰绰有余，甚至我一人就能对付。”严师兄刚刚在何师妹面前表现的自我感觉印象不错，此时笑着说道。
几人交谈着，便要一起前去，这时候后面的林玄出声喊住他们。
“你想一个人独自行动？”
祝红菱俏眉微皱，心生不喜，她巴不得林玄死在百兽林，担心的是林玄死了她没法跟父亲祝天虹交代。

其他几人仿佛听到了天大的笑话一般，都是一脸嘲弄的表情看着林玄。
“是的。”
林玄对于他们的嘲弄视若无睹，他此行的目的有俩个，一个是剑丹药引，另一个则是历练剑法，至于什么任务不任务的，不关他什么事。
说完之后，林玄独自一人离开了，四人看着林玄离去，没有阻拦。
“祝师妹，你已经尽职尽责了，现在是林玄自己执意离开，出了什么事，我们可以为你作证。”邱师兄立马安慰祝红菱说道。
“是啊，这是他咎由自取，出了什么事怪不得你。”
旁边的严师兄跟何师妹也附和说着。
祝红菱盯着林玄的背影冷哼一声，也不要再去理。
......
林玄脱离了几人之后，速度便加快了起来。
经过剑老最后一次灌顶，他的修为元武境下算是没什么对手了，一路上遇到了几头一阶、二阶妖兽，林玄一剑就给解决了。
此时林玄正在跟一头二阶中期妖兽铁皮蛮狮战斗，只见这头蛮狮身形如同一座小山大小，全身皮肤铁黑色，刀枪不入，对着林玄横冲直撞，周围百米之地的树木全部被撞的七零八落。
“砰砰砰！”
铁皮蛮狮每一脚落下都引起地面轻微震动，不仅仅力量大，速度也是无比之快！算是林玄目前遇到的稍微强一些的妖兽。
林玄控制着力度，磨练着自己的剑法。
但这铁皮蛮狮智慧不低，很快明白自己被眼前的人类当成了猴子在耍！
“吼！！！”
二阶中期铁皮蛮狮大吼一声，恼怒不已，铜铃一般大小的狮眼发红，进入了癫狂状态，铁皮变成了红色，防御与气势都加强了不少。
林玄见状，稍微认真了一点，想试试自己刚刚淬炼出来的剑气的锋利程度。
只见他手中铁剑划过天空一刹那，一股子剑气破空而来，透明波澜的空气荡漾出一个微妙波动的波纹。

“咻！”
content_en:
"This...Senior Brother Lin, what do you think?"
After listening to Senior Brother Yan's words, Lin Xuan looked calm and said softly:
"Of course, cultivation is against nature. Whether you live or die depends entirely on the individual."
His character has been tempered for a long time, and he didn't feel any wavering in his heart in response to the ridicule of these people just now. When he was a genius, he not only heard a lot of flattery, but also saw a lot of sarcastic comments from those who flattered him about other disciples with poor qualifications, and he had already looked down on them.
"Hmph, that's good."
Senior Brother Yan seemed to be even more unhappy with Lin Xuan's indifferent attitude and snorted coldly.
Soon, the group took the mission bamboo slips and set off towards the Beast Forest.
...
After being verified by the disciples guarding the formation, they walked into the core of the teleportation formation together. They saw a flash of white light and the five of them disappeared in place.
The next second, he appeared in the sect's trial place, the Forest of Beasts.
"Congratulations to Junior Sister, Junior Sister He, be careful. Falling quickly will cause weight loss, so don't fall."
The two senior brothers had been to the Forest of Beasts many times, and they obviously had some experience. They reminded Zhu Hongling and Junior Sister He, but they completely ignored Lin Xuan on the other side.
Junior Sister He felt weightless and almost fell down in panic. Senior Brother Yan quickly helped her stabilize her body, and then walked towards the gathering place with Junior Sister He talking and laughing.
On this side, Senior Brother Qiu also ran in front of Zhu Hongling and showed his hospitality, but Zhu Hongling was very powerful and didn't need it at all.
After a few people stabilized their bodies, they gathered together again.
"This mission is mainly about the second-level monster inner elixir with the five attributes of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth. I know there is a giant brown bear with the earth attribute in front of me, which happens to be at the early stage of the second level." Senior Brother Qiu said.
"Indeed, I also know that brown bear. Its strength is equivalent to that of an intermediate Yuanwu monk. Although it is extremely powerful, it is more than enough for the few of us to deal with it together. I can even deal with it alone." Senior Brother Yan just showed a good impression of himself in front of Junior Sister He and said with a smile.
Several people were chatting and were about to go together. At this time, Lin Xuan from behind called out to stop them.
"You want to go it alone?"
Zhu Hongling frowned slightly and felt unhappy. She wished that Lin Xuan died in the Forest of Beasts, but she was worried that she would not be able to explain to her father Zhu Tianhong if Lin Xuan died.
The other people looked at Lin Xuan with mocking expressions, as if they had heard a big joke.
"Yes."
Lin Xuan turned a blind eye to their ridicule. He had two purposes for this trip, one was to introduce sword elixirs, and the other was to practice sword skills. As for whether the mission was mission or not, it was none of his business.
After saying that, Lin Xuan left alone. The four of them watched Lin Xuan leave without stopping him.
"Junior sister Zhu, you have done your duty. Now Lin Xuan insists on leaving. If anything happens, we can testify for you." Senior Brother Qiu immediately comforted Zhu Hongling and said.
"Yes, he brought it upon himself. It's not your fault if anything happens."
Senior Brother Yan and Junior Sister He next to him also echoed.
Zhu Hongling stared at Lin Xuan's back and snorted coldly, but ignored it.
...
After Lin Xuan got away from a few people, his speed picked up.
After Jian Lao's last initiation, he had no opponents at the Yuanwu realm. He encountered several first- and second-level monsters along the way, and Lin Xuan dealt with them with one sword strike.
At this time, Lin Xuan was fighting an iron-skinned lion, a mid-level monster beast. The lion was as big as a small mountain, with iron-black skin all over its body. It was invulnerable. It charged towards Lin Xuan, and all the trees within a hundred meters of it were smashed to pieces.
"Bang bang bang!"
Each kick of the iron-clad lion caused slight vibrations on the ground. Not only was it powerful, but it was also extremely fast! It is considered a slightly stronger monster that Lin Xuan has encountered so far.
Lin Xuan controlled the intensity and practicedUse your own swordsmanship.
But this iron-clad lion was very intelligent, and he soon realized that he was being treated like a monkey by the humans in front of him!
"Roar!!!"
The iron-skinned lion roared in the middle stage of the second level, extremely angry. The lion's eyes the size of a copper bell turned red and entered a state of madness. The iron-skinned beast turned red, and its defense and momentum were greatly strengthened.
Seeing this, Lin Xuan became a little more serious and wanted to test the sharpness of the sword energy he had just tempered.
The moment he saw the iron sword in his hand crossing the sky, a stream of sword energy came through the air, and the transparent waves of the air rippled with subtle ripples.
"call out!"
